title: 5 ALTARS YOU MUST RAISE BEFORE 2026 BEGINS
text: I want you to take your phone right now and I want you to share this message with someone. There is a prophetic grace upon this word that will change destinies. Don't keep it to yourself. Someone needs to hear what the spirit of God is about to release. Share it on your WhatsApp. Share it on your timeline. Send it to that prayer group. The Lord is about to speak concerning the altars that will determine your 2026. This is not just another message. This is a prophetic instruction that carries the weight of divine timing. Share it now. And as you share it, you are positioning yourself as a distributor of divine mysteries. And the anointing upon this word will rest upon your own life in Jesus name. Now I need your attention for the next season of this ministration because what I'm about to share with you is not coming from the wisdom of men, but it is [music] coming from the place of the spirit. The Bible makes it very clear that there are seasons and there are times and God operates by times and seasons. Ecclesiastes chapter 3 tells us that to everything there is a season and a time to every purpose under the heaven. We are approaching a threshold. We are approaching a prophetic junction. And what you do before you cross into 2026 [music] will determine what you experience when you get there. You see, in the kingdom of God, altars speak. Altars are not just physical structures. Altars are spiritual realities. Every altar is a place of transaction. Every altar is a place of covenant. Every altar is a place where heaven and earth meet. When you study the Bible from Genesis to Revelation, you will discover that the men and women who had encounters with God, the men and women who walked in unusual grace, the men and women whose [music] destinies were not ordinary, they were people who understood the ministry of altars. Abraham raised altars. Isaac raised altars. Jacob raised altars. Moses raised altars. David raised altars. The altar you raise determines the answer [music] you receive. And so tonight, I stand before you as a messenger of the most high God. And the spirit of the Lord has given me a prophetic instruction to share with you five altars that you must raise before 2026 begins. These are not optional altars. These are mandatory altars. These are altars that will determine whether you enter 2026 as a victim or as a victor. Whether you enter 2026 struggling or whether you enter 2026 from a place of spiritual advantage. The altars you raise in this season will speak for you in the year that is coming. Listen to me very carefully. There is a difference between wishing and working. Many people are wishing for 2026 to be better, but they are not working spiritually to create the atmosphere that will make 2026 better. You cannot be passive in the spirit and expect active [music] results in the natural. The kingdom of God suffers violence and the violent take it by force. This is not the time to be casual about your spiritual life. This is not the time to be playing church. This is not the time to be a religious Christian who knows how to quote scriptures but doesn't know how to raise altars that command heavenly response. The first altar you must raise before 2026 begins is the altar of consecration. Consecration. Can somebody say consecration? You see consecration is not just about fasting and prayer. Though fasting and prayer are part of it. Consecration is about separation unto God. Consecration is about creating a distinction between you and the world. Consecration is about positioning yourself in such a way that when heaven is looking for a candidate through whom to demonstrate power, you qualify because of your consecration. Romans 12:1 says, "I beseech you therefore, brethren, by the mercies of God, that ye present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable unto [music] God, which is your reasonable service." This is the altar of consecration. You are presenting yourself not as a dead sacrifice, but as a living sacrifice. A living sacrifice means you are alive, you are functional, you are operational, but you have been separated unto God. Your body, your mind, your emotions, your decisions, your associations, your entertainment, your conversations, your desires, everything has been presented unto God. The reason why many believers struggle is because they have never raised the altar of consecration. [music] They want the blessings of God, but they are not willing to live the lifestyle that attracts the blessings of God. They want prophetic encounters, but their lives are full of mixture. They want angelic visitations, but their thought life is polluted. They want divine acceleration, but they are committed to the same habits that have been limiting them for years. It doesn't work that way. The altar of consecration demands that you make a decision. You cannot serve God and mammon. You cannot walk with God and walk with the world. You must choose. And I'm prophesying to somebody right now before 2026 begins, you need to have a serious conversation with yourself. You need to look at your life and ask yourself, what needs to go? What relationships need to end? What habits need to be broken? What entertainment needs to be cut off? What association needs to be severed? Because there are things you are carrying into this season that God is not taking with you into 2026. The grace of 2025 tolerated certain things. But the grace of 2026 will not tolerate mixture. 2026 is a year of purity. It is a year of holiness. It is a year where God will separate the precious from the vile. And if you want to walk in the fullness of what God has prepared for 2026, you must raise the altar of consecration. Let me give you practical steps for raising this altar. Number one, dedicate time to fast and pray before the year ends. I'm not talking about a casual one-day fast. I'm talking about a season of consecration where you separate yourself from food, from social media, from distractions, and you give yourself [music] to prayer and to the word of God. Let there be at least seven days, if [music] possible, more where you are seeking the face of God. Where you are asking God to purify your heart, where you are asking God to reveal to you everything in your life that is not pleasing to him. Where you are asking God to give you a fresh baptism of hunger for his presence. Number two, deal with known sin. Stop negotiating with sin. Stop making excuses for sin. Stop calling sin by nice names. If it is fornication, call it fornication. If it is lying, call it lying. If it is bitterness, call it bitterness. If it is pride, call it pride. Call it what it is and repent. True repentance is not just feeling sorry. True repentance is turning away. It is making a covenant with God that you will not go back to that thing again. And I speak prophetically. There is somebody hearing this message and God is dealing with you concerning [music] a particular sin that you have been tolerating. The spirit of God is saying if you don't deal with it now, it will disqualify you from what I have prepared for you in [music] 2026. Deal with it now. Number three, surrender your plans to God. Part of consecration is surrendering your will [music] to the will of God. Many people have their own agenda. They have their own plans. They have their own ideas of what 2026 should look like and they are asking God to bless their plans. But consecration says, "Lord, not my will but your will be done. I surrender my plans to you. I surrender my ambitions to you. I surrender my timeline to you. I surrender my desires to you. Let your will be done in my life." When you raise the altar of consecration, you are telling God, "I am available for your purposes. Use me as you see fit." The second altar you must raise before 2026 begins is the altar of thanksgiving. Thanksgiving. Listen to me, beloved. One of the most powerful spiritual weapons that a believer has is the weapon of thanksgiving. Thanksgiving is not just about saying thank you to God. Thanksgiving is a prophetic declaration that releases divine acceleration. When you thank God, you are not just acknowledging what [music] he has done. You are creating an atmosphere for him to do more. Thanksgiving is the language of faith. It is the language that says, "God, I trust you. I believe you. Even when I don't see it yet, I thank you for it." Psalm 100 vers4 says, "Enter into his gates with thanksgiving and into his courts with praise. Be thankful unto him and bless his name." Do you see that? Thanksgiving is the gate. Thanksgiving is the entrance. You cannot enter into the courts of God with complaining. You cannot enter into the presence of God with murmuring. You cannot access the fullness of God's glory [music] with a spirit of ingratitude. Thanksgiving is the key that opens the door. And I need to tell you something very important tonight. The reason why some people's prayers are not being answered is because they have never learned to thank God. All they do is complain. All they do is ask for more. All they do is focus on what is not working. They wake up in the morning and the first thing they [music] see is what is wrong. They go to bed at night and all they think about is what they don't have. They have become professional complainers and because of that they have shut the door to divine acceleration. Before 2026 begins, you need to raise the altar of thanksgiving. You need to sit down and make a list of everything God has done for you in 2025. [music] I don't care how difficult the year was. I don't care how many challenges you faced. I don't care how many disappointments you experienced. [music] There is something to be grateful for. You are alive. That is something to be grateful for. You can hear this message. That is something to be grateful for. You have your sanity. That is something to be grateful for. You have not been consumed. That is something to be grateful for. God's mercies are new every morning. [music] And if you are still standing, it is because of his grace. Let me tell you what happens when you raise the altar of thanksgiving. Number one, thanksgiving silences the enemy. The enemy thrives on your complaints. When you complain, you empower the enemy. When you mumm, you give the enemy legal ground in your life. But when you begin to thank God in the midst [music] of your situation, the enemy is confused. The enemy cannot understand how you can be going [music] through a storm and still be praising God. Your thanksgiving becomes a weapon that silences the voice of the adversary. Number two, thanksgiving positions you for a testimony. The Bible says, "In everything give thanks, for [music] this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you." When you thank God in advance, you are prophesying your victory. You are declaring that what you are going through is not your end. It is a setup for your testimony. You are telling the enemy, you meant it for evil, but God [music] is turning it for my good. And when you maintain that posture of thanksgiving, God begins to accelerate things in your favor. Number three, thanksgiving attracts divine presence. God inhabits the praises of his people. When you create an atmosphere of thanksgiving, you are inviting the presence of God into your situation. And when the presence of God comes, everything changes. Sickness cannot stay in the presence of God. Poverty cannot stay in the presence of God. Depression cannot stay in the presence of God. Confusion cannot stay in the presence of God. The presence of God brings transformation. And thanksgiving is what attracts that presence. So here is what I want you to do. Before 2026 begins, dedicate at least one day where all you do is thank God [music] from morning till night. Let your mouth be filled with thanksgiving. Thank him for what he has done. Thank him for what he's doing. Thank him for what he's about to do. Thank him for his faithfulness. Thank him for his mercy. Thank him for his grace. Thank him for his protection. Thank [music] him for his provision. Thank him for his wisdom. Thank him for his power. Let your mouth become a fountain of thanksgiving and watch how heaven responds to your gratitude. The third altar you must raise before 2026 begins is the altar of intercession. Intercession. Now listen to me very carefully. Intercession is not the same as personal [music] prayer. Personal prayer is when you are praying for yourself, for your needs, for your family, for your desires. Intercession is when you are standing in the gap for others. Intercession is when you are carrying the burden of the Lord for a people, for a nation, for a generation. Intercession is priestly prayer. It is the kind of prayer that Abraham prayed when he was interceding for Sodom and Gomorrah. It is the kind of prayer that Moses prayed when he stood between God and the children of Israel. It is the kind of prayer that Jesus prayed when he said, "Father, forgive them for they know not what they do." One of the things that distinguishes mature believers from immature believers is the grace of intercession. Immature believers only pray when they have a need. Mature believers pray even when they don't have a need because they understand that prayer is not just about getting things from God. Prayer is about partnering with God to accomplish his purposes in the earth. Intercession is the highest form of prayer because it is selfless. [music] You are not praying for yourself. You are praying for others. You are [music] standing in the gap. You are carrying the burden. You are laboring in prayer for someone else's breakthrough. And I want to tell you tonight that 2026 is going to be a year where intercessors will be celebrated. God is raising up a generation of men and women who will not just pray for themselves, but will stand in the gap for their families, for their communities, for their nations, for the body of Christ. And if you want to walk in the fullness of what God has for you in 2026, [music] you must raise the altar of intercession. Let me give you a prophetic insight. Every time you intercede for someone, you are creating a spiritual deposit in your own life. When you pray for someone else's healing, you are creating an atmosphere of healing over your own life. When you pray for someone else's financial breakthrough, you are creating an atmosphere of provision over your own life. When you pray for someone else's marriage, you are creating an atmosphere of blessing over your own relationships. Intercession is not a loss. Intercession is an investment. What you sow in prayer for others, you will reap in your own life. The Bible says in Genesis 20:17, "So Abraham prayed unto God, and God healed Aimilec and his wife and his maidervants, and they bear children. For the Lord had first closed up all the wombs of the house of Aimilec because of Sarah Abraham's wife. Now watch what happens next. Genesis 21:1 says, "And the Lord visited Sarah as he had said, and the Lord did unto Sarah as he had spoken. For Sarah conceived and bare Abraham a son in his old age, at the set time of which God had spoken to him." Do you see the connection? Abraham interceded for Aimilec's house and immediately after that Sarah conceived. There is a principle here. When you stand in the gap for others, God remembers you. When you pray for someone else's breakthrough, God accelerates your own breakthrough. So before 2026 begins, I want you to raise the altar of intercession. Make a [music] list of people you need to pray for. Your family members who are not yet saved, pray for them. Your friends who are going through difficult [music] times, pray for them. Your pastors and spiritual leaders, pray for them. Your nation, pray for it. The body of Christ, pray for it. Don't just pray one minute prayers. Give yourself to sustained intercession. Labor in prayer. Travail in prayer. Weep in prayer. Groan in prayer. Let your prayers be birthed from a place of burden, from a place of compassion, [music] from a place of love. And I prophesy to somebody tonight as you raise the altar of intercession, God is going to give you supernatural breakthroughs in 2026. Things that you have been praying about for yourself for years are going to suddenly manifest because you took your attention off yourself and began to pray for others. This is a divine principle. It is a kingdom law. When you intercede for others, God fights [music] for you. When you stand in the gap for others, God stands for you. Raise the altar of intercession. The fourth altar you must raise before 2026 begins is the altar of the word. The altar of the word. My dear brothers and sisters, we are living in a generation that is moving away from the [music] word of God. We're living in a generation that values experience more than truth, that values feelings more than doctrine, that values [music] trends more than the word. But I want to tell you tonight that if you are going to survive 2026, if you are going to thrive in 2026, if you are going to walk in victory in 2026, you must become a person of the word. Jesus said in John 6:63, "It is the spirit that quickenth. The flesh profitth nothing." The words that I speak unto you, they are spirit and they are life. The word of God is not just information. The word of God is life. The word of God is not just a book. [music] The word of God is a seed. When you plant the word of God in your heart, it begins to produce [music] fruit in your life. When you meditate on the word of God, it begins to transform your thinking. When you speak the word of God, it begins to create realities in your life. Joshua 1:8 says, "This book of the Lord shall not depart out of thy mouth, but thou shalt meditate therein day and night, that thou mayest observe to do according to all that is written therein. For then thou shalt make thy way prosperous, [music] and then thou shalt have good success." Do you see the key to prosperity? Do you see the key to success? It is the word. It is meditation on the word. It is speaking the word. It is doing the word. Many people are struggling in life because they don't have a [music] word culture. They don't read their Bible. They don't study their Bible. They don't meditate on their Bible. They can spend 3 hours on social media, but they cannot spend 30 minutes in the word of God. They can watch movies for hours, but they cannot [music] read one chapter of the Bible. And then they wonder why their lives are not changing. You cannot neglect the word and expect transformation. It doesn't work that way. Before 2026 begins, you must raise the altar of the word. You must make a decision that you are going to become a student of the [music] word. You are going to give yourself to the study of the scriptures. You are going to meditate on the word day and night. You are going to speak the word over your life, over your family, over your circumstances, over your destiny. Let me give you a practical challenge. between now and the end of the year. Read the entire New Testament. Start from Matthew and read all the way to Revelation. Don't just read it like you are reading a novel. Read it with understanding. Read it with meditation. Read it with prayer. Ask the Holy Spirit to give you revelation. Ask the Holy Spirit to open your eyes to see the mysteries of the word. Ask the Holy Spirit to write the word on the tablets [music] of your heart. And as you read the word, begin to declare the word. Find scriptures that speak to your situation and declare them. If you are believing God for healing, declare Isaiah 53:5, "By his stripes I am healed." If you are believing God for financial breakthrough, I declare Philippians 4:1 19, "My God shall supply all my need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus." If you are believing God for protection, declare Psalm 91. He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most high shall abide under the shadow of the almighty. Let the word become your weapon. Let the word become your defense. Let the word become your foundation. And I prophesy to you tonight as you raise the altar of the word, you are going to begin to walk in a level of wisdom that will shock people. You are going to begin to make decisions that are guided by divine intelligence. You are going to begin to see solutions that others cannot see. You are going to begin to walk in a level of understanding that comes only from the word. The word is going to become a lamp onto your feet and a light onto your path. Raise the altar of the word. The fifth and final altar you must raise before 2026 begins is the altar of faith declarations. faith declarations. Romans 10:17 says, "So then faith cometh by hearing and hearing [music] by the word of God. Faith is not something you feel. Faith is something you speak." Faith is activated by your words. What you say is what you create. The Bible says, "Life and death are in the power of the tongue, and they that love it shall eat the fruit thereof." Many people are frustrated because they have been speaking death over their lives without even knowing it. They wake up in the morning and the first thing they say is, "I'm tired. I'm broke. I'm sick. I'm confused. Nothing is working. My life is a mess." And they don't realize that they are using their own words to create the very reality they are complaining about. Your words are seeds. When you speak negative words, you are planting negative seeds and you will reap a negative harvest. When you speak faithfilled words, you are planting faith seeds and you will reap a faith harvest. Before 2026 begins, you must raise the altar of faith declarations. You must take control of your tongue. You must decide that from now on, you are only going to speak words that are in alignment with what God says about you. You are going to speak words of life. You are going to speak words of faith. You are going to speak words of victory. You are going to speak words of blessing. Let me give you some declarations to begin with. I want you to say this with me. Say, 2026 is my year of supernatural breakthrough. 2026 is my year of divine acceleration. 2026 is my year of unusual favor. 2026 is my year of open doors. 2026 is my year of testimonies. 2026 is my year of harvest. 2026 is my year of answered prayers. 2026 is my year of marital fulfillment. [music] 2026 is my year of financial overflow. 2026 is my year of divine health. 2026 is my [music] year of prophetic encounters. 2026 is my year of angelic visitations. 2026 is my year of God's glory. Do you hear what you just said? Those are not just nice words. Those are prophetic declarations. You are calling into being things that are not as though they were. You are creating your future with your words. And I want you to continue speaking these declarations every single day. When you [music] wake up in the morning, declare it. When you are going to work, declare it. When you are facing a challenge, declare it. When you are tempted to doubt, declare it. Let your mouth become a fountain of faith declarations. And let me tell you what is going to happen as you continue to declare the word of faith. Your spirit man is going to become [music] stronger. Your confidence is going to increase. Your expectation is going to rise. And the atmosphere around you is going to begin to shift. You are going to begin to attract the things you are declaring. You are going to begin to experience the things you are speaking. Faith declarations are not wishful thinking. Faith declarations are spiritual laws in operation. Now beloved, I have given you five altars. The altar of consecration, the altar of thanksgiving, the altar of intercession, the altar of the word, the altar of faith declarations. These are the altars you must raise before 2026 begins. These are not suggestions. These are instructions from the throne of grace. And I want you to understand that raising these altars requires intentionality. It requires commitment. It requires discipline. You cannot be lazy and expect to walk in the fullness of what God has for you. So let me pray with you right now. And as I pray, I want you to engage with this prayer. Don't just listen to me pray. Pray with me. Lift up your voice. Let your heart connect with what I am saying. Are you ready? Let's pray. Father, I thank you for this divine moment. I thank you for everyone who is hearing this message right now. I thank you that this is not a coincidence. This is a divine appointment. Lord, I pray that you will give them the grace to raise these altars. I pray that you will give them the hunger to seek your face. I pray that you will give them the discipline to fast and pray, to study your word, [music] to intercede, to give thanks, to make faith declarations. Father, I speak over every life that is represented here tonight. I decree and declare that 2026 is your year of unprecedented breakthrough. Every limitation is broken right now in the name of Jesus. Every course is reversed right now in the name of Jesus. Every delay is cancelled right now in the name of [music] Jesus. Every satanic agenda is destroyed right now in the name of Jesus. I decree acceleration. I decree multiplication. I decree overflow. I decree open heavens. I decree divine encounters. I decree prophetic breakthroughs. Lord, I pray for everyone who is struggling with consecration. I pray that you will give [music] them the strength to let go of every weight and every sin that so easily besets them. I pray that you will give them a fresh baptism of hunger for your presence. I pray that they will not be satisfied with a mediocre Christian life, but that they will pursue you with everything that is within them. Father, I pray that you will teach them the power of thanksgiving. Let them become thanksgiving experts. Let their mouths be filled with gratitude. Let their hearts overflow with praise. And as they thank you, let your presence [music] fill their homes, their families, their businesses, their ministries. Let thanksgiving become their weapon against every attack of the enemy. Lord, I pray that you will raise up mighty intercessors. I pray that you will give them the grace to stand in the gap, to carry burdens, to labor in prayer. Let them become prayer warriors who will shape the destinies of nations through their intercession. And as they pray for others, let supernatural breakthroughs manifest in their own lives. Father, I pray that you will give them a love for your word. Let the word become sweeter to them than honey. Let the word become their meditation day and night. Let the word transform their thinking, renew their minds, and guide their steps. Let them become people of the word, rooted and grounded in your truth. And Lord, I pray that you will teach them the power of faith declarations. Let their mouths become instruments of creation. Let them speak life, speak victory, speak breakthrough, speak healing, speak prosperity. And as they declare your word, let it manifest in their lives. Let their words create realities. Let their declarations bring heaven to earth. Father, I seal this prayer with the blood of Jesus. I cover every person hearing this message with the blood of Jesus. I decree protection over their lives, their families, their destinies. No weapon formed against them shall prosper. Every tongue that rises against them in judgment is condemned. They are covered. They are protected. They are secured in the name of Jesus. Now receive the grace to raise these altars. Receive the anointing to pray without ceasing. Receive the fire of the Holy Ghost to burn away every hindrance. receive supernatural strength to run and not be weary, to walk and not faint. [music] You are equipped, you are empowered, you are enabled in the name of Jesus. As you step into 2026, [music] you are not going as an ordinary person. You are going as a carer of divine presence. You are going as a voice of the Lord. You are going as a solution to your generation. You are going as more than a conqueror. You are going in the authority of the name of Jesus. And every door that needs to open for you will open. Every mountain that needs to move for you will move. Every breakthrough that needs to manifest for you will [music] manifest. I speak peace to your spirit. I speak clarity to your mind. I speak direction to your path. I speak wisdom for every decision. I speak favor with God [music] and with men. I speak unusual grace that will carry you through every challenge. You will not struggle in 2026. You will not labor in vain. You will not pursue in futility. Everything you touch will prosper. Everywhere you go, you will be a blessing. Every assignment on your life will be fulfilled in the name of Jesus. Now, lift up your hands wherever you are and begin to thank God. Thank him for this word. Thank him for the revelation. Thank him for the instruction. Thank him for the grace he has given you. Thank him for 2026. Thank him for what he's about to do in your life. Open your mouth and give him praise. Let your thanksgiving [music] ascend to heaven right now. This is your moment. This is your season. This is your time. You are coming out. You are breaking forth. You are stepping into the new. Hallelujah.
